t: The comparison he made for his own message
a: رَأَيْتُ الْجَيْشَ بِعَيْنَىَّ، وَإِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْعُرْيَانُ فَالنَّجَا النَّجَاءَ
p: Raʾaytu-l-jaysha bi-ʿaynayy, wa innī ana-n-nadhīru-l-ʿuryān, fa-n-najā-n-najāʾ
m: I have seen the army with my own eyes, and I am the naked warner. Escape, escape.
